lines.text: In the third year of Belshazzar, Daniel saw himself in the citadel of Susa, beside the Ulai Canal.
Daniel saw a ram with two horns charging toward the west, the north and the south.
A goat with a prominent horn came out of the east and shattered the ram's two horns.
A voice called for Michael to explain the vision, and Daniel was told it concerns the time of the end.
Daniel lay ill for days, then got up and went about the king's business.
